levels.name: WIRING (connectome)
levels.claim: the anatomical connectome predicts held-out neurons' responses
levels.control: shuffled wiring collapses -> structure is real, not fit

levels.name: COUPLING (causal propagation)
levels.claim: wiring predicts the causal response to UNSEEN perturbations, incl. new animals
levels.metric: held-out perturbation r=0.141 (38% of ceiling); OOD transfer r=0.236, p=5e-11
levels.control: both shuffles collapse; OOD tested on data NEVER used to build the model

levels.name: ACTIVITY (whole-brain dynamics)
levels.claim: the model forecasts whole-brain activity better than the trivial baseline
levels.control: persistence is the hard trivial null this task is bounded by

levels.name: BEHAVIOR (activity -> locomotion)
levels.claim: neural activity decodes locomotion, beating the published SOTA (Hallinen 2021)
levels.baseline: Hallinen 2021 ridge regression (their features, their splits)
levels.control: shuffle-null decoder is NEGATIVE (collapses) -> decoding is real

levels.name: BODY (stimulus -> behavior, closed loop)
levels.claim: a sensory stimulus drives the command circuit and the correct behavior
levels.metric: bridge 3/3 stimuli directionally correct; c302 forward sim closes stim->command->behavior
levels.baseline: shuffled-valence prior (wrong sign of the sensory input)
levels.control: shuffled valence INVERTS the attractive call (0.265 -> -0.316)

end_to_end.L1_wiring: connectome propagation operator (I-gA)^-1 built from anatomy

verdict: 5-LAYER MODEL VALIDATED (every hop beats a baseline and its control fails; end-to-end trace coherent)
